name: green-zone-fvg-sb-disabled
note: HALF TWO OF A PAIR — identical bars and identical source to green-zone-fvg-sb-exclusive, differing ONLY in inputs.plotSB. `sbFvgUp` is `plotSB and ...`, so disabling it makes the whole conjunction false on every bar and the structure-breaking output must go EMPTY while its zone falls through to the plain output. That fall-through is the Pine's else-if, and it is the half of conversion note 7 that the enabled fixture cannot show. Expect `FVG+ SB` empty and `FVG+` carrying BOTH zones in ascending spawn order: the SB-qualifying one from bar 5 (x1=3, 114/110) followed by the plain one from bar 8 (x1=6, 127/122). The geometry of each zone is byte-identical to its counterpart in the other half — only its OUTPUT changes — which is what makes the pair's multiset guard meaningful rather than a restatement. A regression that made the two outputs overlap rather than partition would show up as a duplicated item here, and one that dropped the SB case entirely would show up as a missing item; neither is visible from either half alone. Mutation-proven: deleting the fallen-through zone from this file fails this fixture AND both cross-fixture guards.
source:
indicator("SBX", shorttitle="SBX", overlay=true)
p = input.int(1, "Pivot Lookup", minval=1, maxval=5)
plotSB = input.bool(true, "Plot Structure Breaking FVG")
pivotTop = pivot.last_high(p, p)
sbFvgUp = plotSB and close[1] > pivotTop and low[1] < pivotTop and high[2] < pivotTop and low > pivotTop
plotzone(fvg.up(0) and sbFvgUp, fvg.up_top(), fvg.up_bottom(), "FVG+ SB", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
plotzone(fvg.up(0) and not sbFvgUp, fvg.up_top(), fvg.up_bottom(), "FVG+", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
